# Learniq

> Learniq is a Nextcloud learning system for schools, training providers and companies: courses, progress, certification and compliance. It is built manifest-first on OpenRegister.

Start with AGENTS.md for the build, test and lint commands. All paths below are relative to the repository root.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint, OpenSpec flow and conventions
- [README.md](README.md): what the app does, installation and development
- [docs/intro.md](docs/intro.md): start page of the documentation site
- [docs/Technical/architecture.md](docs/Technical/architecture.md): architecture
- [docs/Technical/admin-guide.md](docs/Technical/admin-guide.md): administrator guide
- [docs/Features/features.md](docs/Features/features.md): feature overview
- [docs/user-guide/index.md](docs/user-guide/index.md): user and admin guides
- [docs/Integrations/index.md](docs/Integrations/index.md): integrations
- [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md): installation
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution rules and commit format

## API

- [openapi.json](openapi.json): OpenAPI document for the app's JSON API
- [docs/Technical/api.md](docs/Technical/api.md): API reference
- [appinfo/routes.php](appinfo/routes.php): route table

## Specs

- [openspec/specs/](openspec/specs/): one directory per capability, each with a spec.md of requirements and scenarios
- [openspec/changes/](openspec/changes/): open change proposals
- [openspec/architecture/](openspec/architecture/): architecture decision records
- [openspec/README.md](openspec/README.md): how the openspec folder is organised
- [openspec/config.yaml](openspec/config.yaml): rules for proposals, specs and designs
- [lib/Settings/learniq_register.json](lib/Settings/learniq_register.json): the OpenRegister schemas the app installs
